visual: Small carnivorous perennial forming rosettes of long spoon-shaped leaves covered in sticky red or pink glandular hairs that trap insects, with delicate pink flowers.
prune: No pruning required; remove dead flower stems and foliage if necessary.
hardinessNote: Tender in much of the UK; grow under glass or indoors where frost is expected.
resilience: Easy carnivorous plant when kept permanently moist in acidic nutrient-poor conditions.
uses: Carnivorous plant collections, bog gardens, terrariums, conservatories and greenhouses.
